verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party data export feature or open export format for Flagsmith. The Admin API's 'anything you can do in the dashboard' parity is only a developer building block for constructing an export. Self-hosting, OpenFeature SDK portability and audit-log webhooks are adjacent capabilities, not a documented way to export all data and leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
